name: yasir-mods
description: Claude Code mods: bands above the prompt, panes, guards and helpers.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Weather word, percent and 12-turn chart for context usage, above the prompt.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: A bar above the prompt showing context window use by category.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: A pane listing .claude/agents with a run button for each.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds rm -r, git reset --hard, git clean and git push --force until you press Proceed.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Up to three suggested next prompts above the prompt box; a click or 1/2/3 drafts one, never sends.

plugins.name: hover-reveal
plugins.description: Desktop app: masks API keys, tokens and passwords in replies and tool output; hover to show them.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Classifies each turn as mechanical, ordinary or hard and sets model and effort to match; logs every decision.

plugins.name: plugin-confetti
plugins.description: When an MCP tool call finishes, shows that plugin's real logo with a short confetti burst above the prompt; /confetti previews any logo.

plugins.name: decision-picker
plugins.description: When a reply asks you to approve decisions D1, D2, ..., toggles above the prompt; Approve drafts the reply, never sends.

plugins.name: local-sync
plugins.description: Copies each file Claude changes under a source folder to the same path under a target folder, one file at a time; the status line says whether a browser has checked it.

plugins.name: fuel
plugins.description: One band above the prompt showing runway: context window, plan limits with reset countdowns and an estimated cache age as clay-to-red gauges; Compact button; /fuel one-line summary.

plugins.name: recorder
plugins.description: Records every tool call of a turn (name, short target, duration, error) and shows a timeline pane with /recorder; observe only.

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: A slim glowing bar above the prompt showing what Claude is doing, coloured by tool; /pulse and /pulse off.
